blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Sibol secured the Philippines’ second esports medal in the Asian Games, settling for the bronze in the Honor of Kings event after falling to powerhouse China, 0-2, in the semifinals on Monday at Aichi Sky Expo. The Filipinos were outclassed by a Chinese side with nearly a decade of experience in Honor of Kings, which originated in China in 2015 before it made its way to the Philippines in 2024.
